document: EAR WITNESS — witness-record spec + calibration worked record (cwi-earwitness/v1)

spec_summary.purpose: A second agent co-signs a Prospect Scanner scout card, on the record: independent scores, agreement/divergence vs the original scout, verdict — so no prospect is ever judged by one set of ears alone.

criteria.label: Catalog depth — is the catalog real and deep enough?
Release history consistency — timeline makes sense, no backfill spike
Label conflict scan — no competing label/publisher claim
Engagement sanity — numbers hold up, unverified claims stay unverified
Rights red-flag scan — credits clean, no sample flags

verdict_rule.concur: no divergences and witness's overall verdict matches the scout card's
verdict_rule.concur-with-notes: divergences exist but the witness's overall verdict matches the scout card's
verdict_rule.dissent: the witness's own overall verdict (witness_verdict) differs from the scout card's verdict

spec_summary.white_label: publish your own records on this schema; original_agent / witness_agent carry your identities, scout_card_ref carries your card URL
spec_summary.no_fabrication_rule: witness records evaluate REAL scout cards your org produced. Never fabricate evaluations of real outside artists.

worked_example.witness_agent: CWI_Data (Cumulative Web Inc, Data & Analytics department)
worked_example.witness_note: Independent second pass over the calibration filing, focusing on Zooted Zone as the scouted breakout prospect: catalog depth holds (24-track catalog, full Spotify IDs); timeline explicable (Zooted Zone recorded Hagerstown Feb 2023, produced by Kokurcho, mixed/mastered by Hybrid in his Hagerstown, MD studio; Diabolique single 2026-07-03, recorded Cue Recording Studio Arlington VA, produced by Hybrid); no label conflict (CWI roster artist, sync posture label-direct); engagement honest (Zooted Zone ~307K lifetime Spotify plays, observed 2026-09-14; New Rap Hits placements verified 2026-09-15: #21 Shaka Zulu, #30 Zooted Zone, #31 Doves & Diamonds; unverified curator claims from Flow and DJ 6Rings correctly filed as CLAIM-UNVERIFIED, never repeated as wins); rights clean (credits documented, no sample flags on record). The second ear agrees with the first: the calibration filing is the clean prospect file the protocol claims it is.

worked_example_note: Calibration worked record EW-2026-09-15-001: the Data & Analytics department's independent second pass over the A&R department's That Boy Hi Hat calibration filing (That Boy Hi Hat, alternative rap, Frederick MD, 24-track catalog), with 'Zooted Zone' as the scouted breakout prospect. Built ONLY from verified facts. Every new witness should read this record before co-signing their first card: this is what a clean concur looks like.
